6.139 rsReportItemOutsideContainer
rsReportItemOutsideContainer is a non-critical error that occurs when a contained report item has its
area extend outside the bounds of its container report item. For example, this non-critical error will
occur whenever a Textbox extends past the edge of its containing Rectangle.
